```sql
SELECT 
  SUM(ps.points) / COUNT(*)
FROM main.results r
JOIN main.races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN main.constructors c ON r.constructorId = c.constructorId
JOIN main.points_scheme ps ON r.positionOrder = ps.position AND ps.scheme_id = 'PS2010'
WHERE c.constructorRef = 'brawn'
  AND ra.year = 2010
```
